subjects_college_chain_ck.name: subjects_college_chain_ck
subjects_college_chain_ck.value: ("subjects"."academic_year_id" is null or "subjects"."faculty_id" is not null) and ("subjects"."faculty_id" is null or "subjects"."university_id" is not null)

coupon_batches_scope_ck.name: coupon_batches_scope_ck
coupon_batches_scope_ck.value:
("coupon_batches"."scope_type" = 'subject' and "coupon_batches"."subject_id" is not null and "coupon_batches"."teacher_track_id" is null)
     or ("coupon_batches"."scope_type" = 'teacher_track' and "coupon_batches"."teacher_track_id" is not null and "coupon_batches"."subject_id" is null)

coupon_batches_access_ck.name: coupon_batches_access_ck
coupon_batches_access_ck.value:
(case when "coupon_batches"."permanent_access" then 1 else 0 end
        + case when "coupon_batches"."access_duration_days" is not null then 1 else 0 end
        + case when "coupon_batches"."access_expires_at" is not null then 1 else 0 end) = 1

coupons_scope_ck.name: coupons_scope_ck
coupons_scope_ck.value:
("coupons"."scope_type" = 'subject' and "coupons"."subject_id" is not null and "coupons"."teacher_track_id" is null)
     or ("coupons"."scope_type" = 'teacher_track' and "coupons"."teacher_track_id" is not null and "coupons"."subject_id" is null)

entitlements_scope_ck.name: entitlements_scope_ck
entitlements_scope_ck.value:
("entitlements"."scope_type" = 'subject' and "entitlements"."subject_id" is not null and "entitlements"."teacher_track_id" is null)
     or ("entitlements"."scope_type" = 'teacher_track' and "entitlements"."teacher_track_id" is not null and "entitlements"."subject_id" is null)

entitlements_term_ck.name: entitlements_term_ck
entitlements_term_ck.value: ("entitlements"."is_permanent" and "entitlements"."expires_at" is null) or (not "entitlements"."is_permanent" and "entitlements"."expires_at" is not null)

free_access_rules_scope_ck.name: free_access_rules_scope_ck
free_access_rules_scope_ck.value:
("free_access_rules"."scope_type" = 'subject' and "free_access_rules"."subject_id" is not null and "free_access_rules"."teacher_track_id" is null)
     or ("free_access_rules"."scope_type" = 'teacher_track' and "free_access_rules"."teacher_track_id" is not null and "free_access_rules"."subject_id" is null)

free_access_rules_value_ck.name: free_access_rules_value_ck
free_access_rules_value_ck.value:
case "free_access_rules"."rule_type"
        when 'first_n_items' then "free_access_rules"."rule_value" >= 1
        when 'first_n_lessons' then "free_access_rules"."rule_value" >= 1
        when 'percentage' then "free_access_rules"."rule_value" between 1 and 100
        else "free_access_rules"."rule_value" is null end

promotions_scope_ck.name: promotions_scope_ck
promotions_scope_ck.value:
("promotions"."scope_type" = 'subject' and "promotions"."subject_id" is not null and "promotions"."teacher_track_id" is null)
     or ("promotions"."scope_type" = 'teacher_track' and "promotions"."teacher_track_id" is not null and "promotions"."subject_id" is null)
